learned_rules:
- **MIGRATED: buy the pullback, not the high.** Enter only 20–60% off the local high, holding above the hourly low, with 5m volume ≥ $10k and buys > sells (V1, V6). Both winners came in this way: CATBOT and FLOATER, 34% off its high.
- **No buys within ~20% of the local high, even with clean bundles.** SI had 0.65% bundles and lost 38% in 7 min. Near-high skips: 0 ran, 4 dumped.
- **Fresh migration (<1h) going red off the bond spike: wait for a base above the hourly low** (V1). Too-new skips: 4 ran, 6 dumped.
- **Vamp field: buy only the leader** by 5m volume and attention, never the 2nd or 3rd copy (V1, V2).
- **DIP needs a higher low you can see in the data:** a bounce off the hourly low, a pullback that holds above it, and price now above that pullback low. Stop goes just under the higher low. Never buy the first red-to-green candle (V1).
- **DIP attention gate:** full size needs 5m volume ≥ 1x the hourly average. 0.8–1x is a probe, and only if the narrative is strong and current. Under 0.8x is a falling knife: pass. A weak or LARP narrative with sub-1x volume: pass, because dips recover on attention, not on holder tables (V1).
- **Hack stories: pass.** That covers coins whose project got hacked and coins riding a hack headline (hack tickers, exploit plays, Hack Inu copies). They tend to bleed (owner note).
- **A RugCheck "danger" flag that isn't a hard line costs 1 conviction point. It doesn't cap the trade.** Name the flag, then size normally from the lower conviction. Its skips: 3 ran, 2 dumped.
- **Hard blocks stay:** top 10 >25%, dev >1%, bundles/insiders over the line, mint/freeze, LP, political figure (V6, V13, V17).
- **Take initials at 1.5x with sell-initials (V11). If the prior high I'm targeting sits below 1.5x, take them there.** CPU and FLOAT peaked around 1.6x and closed red; SWAN topped at exactly its named 1.40x.
- **At 1.3x, move the stop to break-even after fees.** A 1.6x peak must never close red.
- **Before initials only: if I'm green and 5m volume drops to half its hourly pace, sell half.**
- **After initials, the runner rides a 35% trail and nothing else sells it.** No early exits and no tightening on a hunch. One CATBOT-sized run pays for ten small losses.
- **Time stop: still under 1.0x at 45 min with no volume surge means exit, with no extensions** (V1). FLOAT was held to 158 min and still lost.
- **Stop review: SELL** if the trade never went green and hit the stop in under 15 min (a bad entry), or if top-10/insider share dropped and price keeps bleeding. Hold once only if narrative and 5m volume are clearly intact, with a new stop and a deadline. **Re-enter a stopped coin only when it reclaims the prior high**, never mid-range.
